title: Safety Case Method Statement
description: Free Safety Case Method Statement template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers facility information, 3.0 safety case structure, 4.0 safety critical elements (sces) register.
standard: Offshore Installations and Wells (Design and Construction, etc) Regulations
html:
Facility Information

METHOD STATEMENT ID: SC-MS-__________ DATE: ______________ REVISION: ______________

FACILITY/ RIG: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ FIELD: ______________

OPERATOR: ______________ REGULATORY BODY: ______________ VERIFICATION BODY: ________

SAFETY CASE TYPE: ☐ Design ☐ Operation ☐ Combined VALIDITY PERIOD: ______________ to ______________

1.0 Scope: This Document Outlines The Safety Case Management System For The Facility.

2.0 REGULATORY REFERENCES:

• Offshore Installations (Safety Case) Regulations

• Health and Safety at Work Act

• Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations

• Relevant national regulations (_____________)

3.0 Safety Case Structure

SECTION 1: FACILITY DESCRIPTION

• Facility overview and layout

• Main systems and equipment

• Operational parameters

• Accommodation and manning levels

SECTION 2: SAFETY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (SMS)

• Safety policy and objectives

• Organizational structure and responsibilities

• Competence and training

• Permit to work system

• Safety representatives and committees

SECTION 3: MAJOR HAZARD IDENTIFICATION

• Hazard identification process

• Major Accident Hazard (MAH) register

• Hydrocarbon releases

• Process safety risks

• Structural integrity risks

• Marine operations risks

• Dropped objects

• Ship collision

• Helicopter operations

• Fire and explosion

SECTION 4: RISK ASSESSMENT

• Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA)

• Temporary Refuge (TR) impairment

• Escape, Evacuation and Rescue (EER) analysis

• Individual Risk Per Annum (IRPA)

• Societal risk (PLL)

• ALARP demonstration

SECTION 5: CONTROLS AND MITIGATIONS

• Primary controls (prevention)

• Secondary controls (detection and control)

• Tertiary controls (mitigation and EER)

• Performance standards

• Safety Critical Elements (SCEs)

• Verification scheme

SECTION 6: EMERGENCY RESPONSE

• Emergency Response Plan (ERP)

• Emergency organization and roles

• Muster and evacuation procedures

• Temporary Refuge (TR) procedures

• Rescue and first aid

• External emergency support

• Communication during emergencies

SECTION 7: WELL OPERATIONS (if applicable)

• Well control philosophy

• Well operations risk assessment

• Barrier philosophy

• BOP and well control equipment

• Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS)

SECTION 8: PERFORMANCE MONITORING

• Safety performance indicators

• Audit schedule

• Inspection and maintenance

• Incident reporting and investigation

• Management review
